message.content:
Here’s a quick mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films across several sub‑genres—so you’ll have something whether you’re into psychological dread, supernatural chills, or gore‑heavy thrills:

| # | Title (Year) | Sub‑Genre | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|--------------|-----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** (1960) | Psychological Thriller | Hitchcock’s masterclass in suspense; the shower scene is legendary. |
| 2 | **The Shining** (1980) | Gothic/Survival | Kubrick’s eerie adaptation of Stephen King with haunting visuals. |
| 3 | **Halloween** (1978) | Slasher | The original “killer mask” film that defined the slasher formula. |
| 4 | **The Exorcist** (1973) | Supernatural | One of the most unsettling exorcism stories ever told. |
| 5 | **Hereditary** (2018) | Family/Occult | A modern psychological horror that blends grief with supernatural terror. |
| 6 | **Get Out** (2017) | Social Commentary | Satirical horror that tackles race while delivering genuine scares. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Survival/Science Fiction | Silence is survival; the tension never lets up. |
| 8 | **Midsommar** (2019) | Folk Horror | Daylight dread—an unsettling festival in Sweden. |
| 9 | **It Follows** (2014) | Urban Legend | A fresh take on the “invisible stalker” trope. |
|10 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological/Family | A metaphorical monster that feels very real. |
|11 | **Saw** (2004) | Torture/Thriller | The first of a long line of puzzle‑based horror. |
|12 | **The Ring** (2002) | Paranormal | A cursed videotape that still feels creepy today. |
|13 | **Paranormal Activity** (2007) | Found Footage | Low‑budget found footage that made a huge impact. |
|14 | **The Cabin in the Woods** (2012) | Meta‑Horror | A clever twist on the “cabin‑in‑the‑woods” trope. |
|15 | **Suspiria** (1977) | Giallo | Dario Argento’s color‑driven, dance‑filled nightmare. |

Feel free to pick based on what kind of scare you’re after—whether it’s a slow‑burn psychological thriller or a jump‑scare‑packed slasher. Happy watching!
